business_summary: DM Solutions Co.,Ltd engages in the marketing business in Japan. It operates in three segments: Direct Mail Business, Internet Business, and Apparel Business. The company offers logistics solutions, including support services for shipping and mail-order operations, such as ordering processing, payment services, and customer service; IP planning and management; IP Production; and direct mail marketing services comprising direct mail and postal mail delivery services; machinery and equipment, which include film wrapping machine, film envelope inserter, buscro printer, and paper envelope inserter; security system; printing services, such as pamphlets, booklets, promotional materials, direct mail, envelopes, advertising flyers, business cards, postcards, invitations, posters, Invoice and form printing, calendars and fans, and tack seals; and cellmarketing. It also provides web marketing services comprising SEO consulting, content marketing, website creation, advertising management, SNS operation agency, recruitment branding support, shopify website creation service, and web marketing support tool intimateSEO; media production and operation; media management; and design management, including planning and design, as well as production, such as corporate websites, web advertisement, print media, video production, trade show participation assistance, logo creation, and store tool design. In addition, the company operates BeeMe, a Manuka honey specialty store; pureLi, a lifestyle brand; and RHET, a D2C car care brand. Further, it sells clothing and other products through e-commerce sites. DM Solutions Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Musashino, Japan.
